title: Birth, Marriage & Death Certificates (Certified Copy & Endorsement)
officeLocation: Iriga City Hall, Sta. Cruz Sur, Iriga City
whoCanApply: Registered individuals, parents/spouses, or authorized representatives with a signed authorization letter and valid government ID.
summary: Request certified true copies, local civil registry transcriptions, timely or delayed registration of birth, marriage, or death, marriage licenses, and PSA endorsement for civil registry records registered in Iriga City.
steps: Visit the City Civil Registrar's Office at Iriga City Hall (or email localcivilregistraririgacity@gmail.com for preliminary inquiry).
Fill out the verification/request slip with the full name, date of event (birth, marriage, or death), and parents' or spouses' names.
Pay the prescribed local civil registry fee at the City Treasurer's Office cashier window and present the Official Receipt.
Claim the Certified True Copy, Marriage License, or PSA Endorsement at the releasing window.
requirements: Valid government-issued ID of the requester
Signed Authorization Letter + valid ID of document owner (if requested by a representative)
Official Receipt from the City Treasurer's Office
For Late Registration: Negative Certification from PSA and supporting baptismal/school/medical records
feeNote: Data not yet available online — exact fee depends on transaction type under the 2020 Iriga City Revised Revenue Code (Ordinance No. 2020-02) and Citizen's Charter.
processingTimeNote: Same-day release for verification/certified copies; 10-day statutory posting period for Marriage Licenses and Delayed Registrations.
gaps: Exact itemized schedule of civil registry fees is inside the downloadable 2022 Citizen's Charter PDF (CGO-IRIGA-CITIZENS-CHARTER-2022.pdf).

title: Mayor's Business Permit (New Application & Annual Renewal)
officeName: Local Economic Development & Investment Promotions Office (LEDIPO) / BPLO
officeLocation: Iriga City Hall Complex, Sta. Cruz Sur, Iriga City
whoCanApply: Sole proprietors, partnerships, corporations, and cooperatives operating or opening a business in Iriga City.
summary: Apply for a new Mayor's Permit to Operate or renew an existing business license through Iriga City's Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS) and LEDIPO, in compliance with the 2020 Revised Revenue Code (Ordinance No. 2020-02) and Mandatory CCTV Ordinance (Ordinance No. 2023-24).
steps: Submit your Unified Business Permit Application Form along with DTI/SEC/CDA registration and Barangay Business Clearance.
Undergo one-stop regulatory assessment (Zoning/Locational, Sanitary/Health, Engineering/Building, Fire Safety Inspection, and CCTV compliance under Ordinance No. 2023-24 where applicable).
Receive the Order of Payment (Tax Order of Payment) and pay business taxes and regulatory fees at the City Treasurer's Office.
Claim your Mayor's Business Permit, Business Plate/Sticker, and Official Receipt.
requirements: DTI Business Name Registration (Sole Proprietorship), SEC Registration (Corporation/Partnership), or CDA Certificate (Cooperative)
Barangay Business Clearance from the Iriga barangay where the business is located
Proof of right to use business location (Title, Tax Declaration, or Contract of Lease)
Prior year's Gross Sales Declaration / Audited Financial Statement (for renewals)
Sanitary Permit (CHO), Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (BFP), and CCTV compliance check (for covered establishments under Ordinance No. 2023-24)
feeNote: Computed based on business capitalization (new) or prior-year gross receipts (renewal) under Ordinance No. 2020-02 (2020 Iriga City Revised Revenue Code).
processingTimeNote: Streamlined processing under RA 11032 (Ease of Doing Business) and the Iriga City Citizen's Charter.

title: Real Property Tax (Amilyar) Payment, Tax Clearance & Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
officeHead: Mrs. Segundina V. Egipto (Acting City Treasurer)
officeLocation: Iriga City Hall, Sta. Cruz Sur, Iriga City
whoCanApply: Property owners, residents aged 18 and above, businesses, and corporations in Iriga City.
summary: Pay annual Real Property Tax (RPT / Amilyar), secure a Real Property Tax Clearance Certificate, or obtain a Community Tax Certificate (Cedula) required for notarization, employment, and business permits.
steps: For Real Property Tax (RPT): Present your latest Official Receipt or Tax Declaration Number at the City Treasurer's Office RPT Window for billing computation.
Pay the assessed amount at the Cashier Window (early annual payments qualify for prompt-payment discounts under the Revised Revenue Code).
For Cedula (Community Tax Certificate): Present a valid ID and declare gross income/receipts at the Cedula Window, pay the fee, and sign/thumbmark your CTC.
Collect your Official Receipt or Real Property Tax Clearance.
requirements: For RPT Payment: Previous year's Official Receipt or Tax Declaration Number (ARP/TD No.)
For Tax Clearance: Latest RPT Official Receipt and valid ID
For Cedula (CTC): Valid government ID and proof/declaration of gross annual income
feeNote: Assessed under Ordinance No. 2020-02 (2020 Iriga City Revised Revenue Code) and the Local Government Code (RA 7160).
processingTimeNote: 15 to 30 minutes for walk-in Cedula and RPT assessment/payment.

For Transfer or New Assessment: Submit Deed of Conveyance, BIR eCAR, Transfer Tax Receipt, and Title for appraisal and tax mapping verification.
Claim your updated Tax Declaration or Certification.

Latest Real Property Tax Official Receipt / Tax Clearance from City Treasurer's Office
For Transfer of Ownership: Certified copy of Title (TCT/OCT), Deed of Sale/Donation/Extrajudicial Settlement, BIR Certificate Authorizing Registration (eCAR), and Transfer Tax Receipt

title: Building Permit, Occupancy Permit & Excavation/Fencing Clearances
officeName: City Engineer's Office (Office of the Building Official)
officeHead: Engr. Eddie M. Belmonte (Acting City Engineer)
officeLocation: Iriga City Hall, Sta. Cruz Sur, Iriga City

steps: Secure a Locational / Zoning Clearance first from the City Planning and Development Coordinator's Office (OCPDC) and Architectural design review if required.
Submit signed and sealed building plans, structural computations, bill of materials, and ownership documents to the City Engineer's Office.
Undergo site inspection and Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) endorsement with the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
Pay the assessed National Building Code fees at the City Treasurer's Office and claim your Building or Occupancy Permit.

Five (5) sets of architectural, structural, electrical, and sanitary/plumbing plans signed and sealed by licensed professionals
Bill of Materials, Cost Estimates, and Technical Specifications
Certified True Copy of Land Title (TCT), latest Tax Declaration, and Real Property Tax Receipt
Locational Clearance (OCPDC), Barangay Construction Clearance, and BFP Fire Safety Clearance
feeNote: Computed per square meter and building category under the National Building Code (PD 1096) Schedule of Fees.
processingTimeNote: 3 to 7 working days upon submission of complete plans and clearances.
